scope: Real full tick; native Canvas and browser DOM stubbed; frames of 1/64 s; a desk of 1440×900 (the stories at 1900×810); the worker of Wings headless (a second copy of the page's script, messages as structured clones) thinking sixteen rehearsed frames a frame. With Cohort's rules taken out and no budget, the tour of changes and the chain through every page from every other are Amoeba's, the world and every drawing command, frame by frame; with them in, every change that does not go from a page to a page is. On the chain through every page from every other (an essay's changes counted apart): the gallery crosses the screen on fewer changes than on Amoeba, its cards travel less, less of their area is drawn outside the gallery's box (how much of the box no cell draws is reported), the opening image swells less in it and the closing image keeps less of its size in it, the closing image is drawn beyond what it bids less, and the changes draw fewer defects; nothing waits, nothing fractures, from each round that moved a cell the performance is that round's rehearsal of the move to the bit, every change has one pace, every page at rest is exact. The same on the tour. With no worker the hive thinks on the page and plays what it rehearsed. A Cue story is Amoeba's frame by frame; a Tell and a Tell II story run to their end and home without a fractured cell. The defects drawn are reported against Amoeba.
